facts.fact: Adwave says local businesses need reach to roughly 1,000-10,000 people in their service area to know them and trust them.
facts.quote: You need the 1,000-10,000 people in your service area to know you exist and trust you.

facts.fact: Adwave says its streaming TV ads can start running for as little as $30 a day.
facts.quote: With [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works/), you can create a TV commercial in minutes and start running it on major streaming platforms for as little as $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave says its streaming TV ads can reach local viewers on NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ premium channels.
facts.quote: you can reach local viewers on NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ premium channels.

facts.fact: Adwave estimates the total ongoing time commitment for its 'quiet' marketing system at 2-4 hours per week.
facts.quote: Total ongoing time commitment: 2-4 hours per week.

facts.fact: Adwave says a monthly email to existing customers takes about an hour.
facts.quote: A monthly email takes an hour and reaches people who already trust you.

facts.fact: Adwave says a TV campaign requires creating one 30-second ad rather than recurring posts.
Adwave's quiet marketing timeline suggests creating one optional evergreen social post per week.
facts.quote: Create one evergreen social post per week (optional)
